matrix_rule.bbvi_weight: default_food_weight; the screen recomputes with its slider
matrix_rule.cell_colour_rule: A public cell takes the first type in cell_colour_precedence among the species recorded there. High-MCUI types come first so a conservation-priority species is never hidden (precautionary approach); among high-MCUI types the more restrictive use comes first; among low-MCUI types the one with high-BBVI evidence comes first. A cell with more than one type is marked mixed and lists the count per type. Cells without a typed species stay 'held' (grey).
matrix_rule.map_meaning: 출현 기록이 있는 셀 × 종 유형. 해역의 자원량·분포·해역 점수가 아님.
matrix_rule.national_mcui_note: A national red-list MCUI is placed with a distinct marker; it is not on the IUCN scale and is never ranked with it.
matrix_rule.substitute_mcui_note: An official national list of another range state is placed with the separate marker used for the Korean national MCUI and labelled by its basis. A preliminary Rapid LC gives no MCUI: its post-hoc back-test failed (it called the EN species 해삼 and 전복 likely LC), so it is shown on the species as reference information only (team-lead decision 2026-10-02).
matrix_rule.threshold_rule: A value at or above the threshold is high. BBVI is compared as published, rounded to one decimal (the screen's BBVI at the current weight is rounded the same way); MCUI category scores are whole numbers.

bioactivity_leads.exclusion_reason: Extract and purchased standard cannot be linked as one species-derived single compound activity.
No confirmed CID/InChIKey to assay chain; MIC/MFC cannot be converted to IC50.
Structure ID, tabulated IC50 and producing organism are not established.
A real isolated-peptide IC50 is available, but an exact public structure join and comparable fixed cohort are not yet verified; do not mix peptides with small molecules.
Whole-extract animal outcomes cannot be assigned to a single compound or converted to pChEMBL.
Quantified fraction effects and qualitative single-compound observations are not an eligible compound-level MBPI input.
Paper-local IC50 is real but incomplete source-taxonomy and exact-molecule joins and no comparable assay cohort prohibit MBPI; cell viability is not proof of clinical efficacy.
Isolated peptide origin is documented, but the accessible assay record is insufficient for a reproducible potency percentile.
A partly characterized hydrolysate peptide cannot support a compound-identified, comparable MBPI percentile.
